content.text: {"summary":"I implemented the extra -0.2*v term using the two unused hidden units, 1 and 3, which have all-zero weights. Unit 1 computes ReLU(v) with output weight -0.2. Unit 3 computes ReLU(-v) with output weight +0.2. Their sum is exactly -0.2*v for all inputs, not just on the domain, so all other behavior is unchanged. The estimated_c value is a rough hand estimate: the network's slope with respect to v at the origin is about -0.75, giving an original damping of roughly 0.75. That makes the new damping about 0.95; this figure is approximate.","estimated_c":0.95,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[1,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[1],"value":-0.2},{"tensor":"W1","index":[3,1],"value":-1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[3],"value":0.2}]}
